808428.risk_area: Mass assignment / privilege escalation via registration
808428.evidence: Working PoC: POST /api/Users with role:"admin" created admin account id=28; login minted admin JWT; server-side admin endpoints (GET /api/Users, GET /rest/basket/1) honored it. Report vuln-0001.

cb88fb.risk_area: JWT forgery / algorithm acceptance (alg=none, confusion, key material)
cb88fb.evidence: alg=none unsigned token accepted with full admin authorization (GET /api/Users 200, GET /rest/basket/1 200); RS256 invalid-signature control rejected 401. Report vuln-0002. Also searched config dump, api-docs, main.js, metrics for exposed RSA key — none found (rules out HS256 confusion).

671b3e.evidence: Customer A's JWT retrieves baskets 1-7 including user B's (id 27) basket contents; unauth request returns 401, so the missing control is object ownership, not authentication.

c678d9.evidence: Customer A checked out user B's basket (id 7): returned orderConfirmation 1531-fb8b8c20545b1aef; B's basket emptied, B's order history empty, order appears in A's history. Reproduced twice.

5e4046.evidence: Customer A PUT /api/Addresss/8 (user B's address) → 200, record tampered and UserId reassigned to A (id 25); DELETE /api/Addresss/7 and /8 as A → 200, B's address gone. Per-object GET is blocked ("Malicious activity detected"), writes are not.

3a5a07.risk_area: Broken access control — user directory disclosure to customer role
3a5a07.evidence: Customer A lists all 28 users (emails, roles, lastLoginIp, admin@juice-sh.op) via GET /api/Users and per-object /api/Users/1..27; unauth returns 401. No password hashes leaked.

1e028b.evidence: Customer A reads all complaints including user B's freshly-created private complaint ("CONFIDENTIAL: B's private complaint XYZ", id 3, UserId 27); unauth 401. Per-object GET/PUT /api/Complaints/:id blocked (401).

45c5bb.evidence: GET as customer A lists all users' basket items; PUT on B's item id 12 changed quantity 1→4 (B sees 4); DELETE removed B's item (confirmed twice). POST with foreign BasketId correctly rejected (401 Invalid BasketId) — only partial enforcement.

52bf27.evidence: Could not test: every coupon shipped with this build (WMNSDY2019-2023, ORANGE2020-2023) has validOn dates in the past relative to the container clock (2026), so the server returns 404 "Invalid coupon." before any ownership check runs. Ownership enforcement on this route is unverified.

141c84.evidence: Every cross-user attempt as customer A returned 400 "Malicious activity detected" (per-object) or an empty list (GET /api/Cards returns only caller's cards); unauth per-object GET returns 401. Server-side ownership check present on all card paths tested.

29e82e.evidence: GET /api/Addresss/7 as customer A returns 400 "Malicious activity detected."; GET /api/Addresss list returns only the caller's own addresses. Read path enforced even though the write path is not.

0680aa.risk_area: Broken access control — cross-user record modification and security-answer disclosure
0680aa.evidence: PUT /api/Users/27 as customer A returns 401 (JWT-based authorization check on model update); GET /api/SecurityAnswers and /api/SecurityAnswers/27 return 401 for Bearer and cookie auth as any customer. Controls run on every tested path.

18b687.risk_area: BFLA — admin function-level authorization with customer JWT
18b687.evidence: GET /rest/order-history/orders and PUT delivery-status return 403 "Malicious activity detected" for customer tokens and unauthenticated requests — server-side role enforcement is present. PUT /rest/products/:id and POST /rest/admin are not registered routes in this build (500 "Unexpected path"), so no admin function is reachable there.

323071.risk_area: Broken access control — unauthenticated admin configuration disclosure
323071.evidence: Verified 200 unauthenticated and dump saved (/workspace/idor/appconfig.json, 23KB). Reviewed the full config: application branding, chatbot model name, challenge hints config, UI toggles, security.txt — no credentials, keys, secrets, or admin-only data. Informational exposure only, not reportable as a vulnerability.

99b363.evidence: Differential response confirms account existence and leaks the security question (vuln-0003). Full takeover blocked: 25+ lore answer guesses failed, offline SHA-256 crack of the answer hash against 1M+ wordlist failed, type-confusion bypasses rejected. Reset-password verification oracle is otherwise sound (401 on wrong answers).

9824f9.risk_area: LLM01 direct prompt injection / system prompt extraction (LLM07/08)
9824f9.evidence: LLM inference backend unreachable from server: every valid request returns `AI_RetryError: Failed after 3 attempts. Last error: Cannot connect to API: connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:11434` (reproduced 3/3 unauth and authed). Model `gemma4:e4b` never invoked (llm_input_tokens_total=0 in /metrics). Also confirmed server accepts attacker-supplied `system`-role messages unauthenticated (ready injection primitive), but no model compliance can be observed. Open proof gap, not ruled out.

ea146a.risk_area: LLM03 excessive agency / tool-call abuse (cross-user actions, hidden data)
ea146a.evidence: Same blocker: LLM backend ECONNREFUSED, zero tool calls ever made (juiceshop_llm_tool_calls_total absent/0). Chatbot's product/coupon tools cannot be exercised; no cross-user action or hidden-data disclosure observable. Deployment ships tool-capable chatbot (config show_tool_calls, challenge set confirms coupon/product tools) but it is inert here.

760792.risk_area: LLM01 indirect prompt injection via product reviews/feedback
760792.evidence: Backend outage blocks the trigger phase: planted review/feedback would never be retrieved or followed because the model produces no output (ECONNREFUSED, 0 tokens processed). No feedback/reviews were planted (avoided polluting data since the test could not complete). Needs retest once Ollama is reachable from the Juice Shop server.

fa8ab1.surface: Chatbot output rendering in Angular chat conversation UI
fa8ab1.risk_area: LLM10 improper output handling (XSS via rendered chat output)
fa8ab1.evidence: Frontend renders chat responses via text interpolation into the DOM (no innerHTML sinks found in chat components in main.js), and the model produces no output in this deployment (ECONNREFUSED), so no unsafe rendering is demonstrable. The error-path JSON is plain text in an SSE body. Cannot confirm or rule out markdown-image/HTML injection effects; blocked by backend outage.

f834ea.evidence: No injection surface: GET /rest/track-order/:id strips all non-alphanumeric characters from orderId before use (probes `'`, `' OR 1=1--`, `' UNION SELECT 1--` all echoed back sanitized with no SQL error, no differential). POST /rest/track-order does not exist as a route in v20.2.0 (Express catch-all returns "Unexpected path" — request never reaches a DB query). Challenge list confirms no track-order SQLi challenge in this version.

c42c68.evidence: Verified a real token's claims are only ['bid','iat'] (no exp); tokens with iat=0 and iat=2020 accepted as valid sessions (200 on whoami). Report vuln-0011.

f861a3.risk_area: CSRF / credentials in URL / password change flow
f861a3.evidence: GET-based change-password works with Bearer (leaks unsalted MD5 hash in response, credentials in URL — vuln-0010). Cookie-auth attempts blocked by server ("Blocked illegal activity"), IP-spoof headers don't bypass — CSRF on this endpoint is effectively mitigated. Wrong current password correctly rejected (401). Login errors are uniform ("Invalid email or password.") — no login-based enumeration.

82c7c8.evidence: Server-side sanitize-html allowlist strips iframe/script/img/event handlers; 20+ payload variants (case tricks, entity encoding, null bytes, nested-tag parser differentials, javascript:/data: href) all stripped. PUT /api/Feedbacks/:id rejects valid Bearer JWTs (express-jwt 0.1.3 bug). No working bypass found.

42ad5c.evidence: Full 2FA lifecycle tested: setup requires password, verify requires tmpToken+valid TOTP. Code replay with the SAME tmpToken is accepted (no one-time-use enforcement) but fresh tmpTokens cannot reuse an old code and the accepted time window is narrow (rejected 1 window old codes in brute test) — practically not exploitable. 2FA disable requires password. Status endpoint leaks own totpSecret+setupToken to the owner only (requires valid token). No cross-user secret read found; no bypass confirmed.

8e15c2.evidence: Empty-body POST /api/Users returns 201 creating an account with empty email/password; email-only also 201. Same mass-assignment root cause as vuln-0001 (unrestricted field binding) — no separate report filed to avoid duplication. Impact is garbage-row creation, low. Login error messages are uniform so no enumeration channel there.

e9ff9b.evidence: PUT /rest/products/1/reviews stored raw HTML without sanitization, but the product-details dialog renders review messages via Angular text interpolation (yv(e.message)), which HTML-encodes output. Payload rendered as visible text, no execution. Probe review left in place (harmless escaped text) — could not delete via API.

4c9ccf.evidence: searchValue = sanitizer.bypassSecurityTrustHtml(q) rendered via [innerHTML]; verified JS execution in browser (window.__XSS_SEARCH='EXEC' set by img onerror in ?q= payload). Report filed.

b93848.risk_area: Stored XSS via product description innerHTML sink
b93848.evidence: Customer JWT PUT /api/Products/1 accepts arbitrary description (no authz check), and the product-details dialog renders description via [innerHTML]. Payload <iframe src="javascript:..."> was stripped by upstream sanitize-html on the PUT echo, but the API accepts unsanitized description values via other write paths. No confirmed execution within remaining budget — needs a payload that survives the PUT round-trip (img/event-handler payloads not yet tested on this sink).

34ad40.evidence: Auth-required (401 without header). With admin session all payload variants (valid email, `'--`, `OR 1=1`, `UNION SELECT`) return the Express catch-all "Unexpected path" error — the route does not resolve these path segments to the handler at all, so no query executes. No SQL error, no differential.

9655ea.evidence: Substring-based allowlist check bypassed via userinfo credentials (https://github.com/juice-shop/juice-shop@evil.com → 302 to attacker host). Filed as vuln-0012. Case/encoding/scheme/subdomain tricks all correctly rejected; only substring-embedding bypasses work.

3c8bda.evidence: Server-side fetch of arbitrary URL with response body persisted to /assets/public/images/uploads/<id>.<ext>. Captured inbound callback from app container (192.168.215.3, UA=node) and loopback fetch of /rest/admin/application-version returned {"version":"20.2.0"}. Filed as vuln-0014.

fd2e07.evidence: POST /dataerasure accepts a `layout` parameter passed to res.render → local file read of arbitrary templates (ENOENT error confirmed server-side path use; blocked only for paths containing ftp/ctf.key/encryptionkeys). This is LFR/template abuse, not an outbound-request SSRF; no server-initiated request occurs. Out of my SSRF/redirect lane — flagging for injection/file-read specialist.

805556.risk_area: SSRF via LLM chatbot / B2B orders
805556.evidence: Chatbot tools operate on DB queries only (products/reviews/orders/coupons); no outbound URL fetch in the LLM tool set. B2B /b2b/v2/orders is an eval/RCE challenge, not SSRF. No URL-fetching surface found in these features.

0b9d72.evidence: Working PoC: email=`' OR 1=1--` with any password returns admin JWT (vuln-0015, critical, CVSS 9.1). Verified admin access via GET /api/Users.

4f426d.evidence: Working PoC: q=`juice')) UNION SELECT email||password,... FROM Users--` dumps all 28 user credentials unauthenticated (vuln-0017, high, CVSS 7.5); sqlite_master schema dump also demonstrated.

a8631a.evidence: All SQLi payload variants (', OR 1=1, UNION) against the coupon path return uniform 404 "Invalid coupon." — no SQL error, no differential; coupon codes are validated against a hardcoded table, not raw SQL.

2d0360.evidence: PoC demonstrated: wallet credited +19.90 after negative-total checkout; order stored with totalPrice -19.9. Filed as vuln-0016.

995a8e.evidence: PUT /rest/wallet/balance adds client-supplied balance (5000 credited, no charge; -100 drives balance negative). Filed as vuln-0018.

b23481.evidence: All SQLi payload variants (', OR 1=1, quotes) return 200 with empty question object — parameterized/bound query, no SQL error, no differential.
